fields.description: Shown to users when they pick a size, e.g. Small
fields.label: Size Label

fields.description: Credits burnt per running hour. 0 = this size is free.
fields.label: Credits per Hour

fields.description: Exactly one size is the default. Clear the current default before setting another.
fields.label: Is Default

fields.description: Ascending display order on the pricing table and the size picker.
fields.label: Sort Order

fields.description: Docker memory limit, e.g. 1g. Read at deploy, not copied onto the Lab.
fields.label: Memory Limit

fields.description: Clamped to the host's core count at deploy. Minimum 1.
fields.label: CPU Cores

fields.description: Sites allowed on one instance of this size. 0 = unlimited.
fields.label: Max Sites

fields.description: Multiplies every lease plan's price on this size. 1.0 = the catalog price.
fields.label: Price Multiplier

fields.description: The duration a lab on this size deploys at, unless the lab names its own.
fields.label: Default Lease Plan

fields.description: Writable-layer quota in GB. 0 = unlimited. Only enforced on overlay2 over xfs; anywhere else the deploy logs it as skipped.
fields.label: Disk Limit (GB)

fields.description: Max number of processes (PIDs) a bench of this size may spawn. Leave 0 for the default (500).
fields.label: Max Processes (PID limit)

fields.description: Read/write IOPS cap per host block device. Leave 0 for the default (1000).
fields.label: Max IOPS (Block I/O)

fields.description: Read/write throughput cap in bytes/sec per host block device. Leave 0 for the default (40 MiB/s).
fields.label: Max Bytes/sec (Block I/O)

fields.description: Whether a bench of this size runs code-server. Off means no IDE and no public ide- hostname.
fields.label: Include Code Server
